transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's a pleasure to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. Well, I suppose what brings me in is... I just don't have the push I used to have. 

I used to go to choir, do my quilting, and go out visiting folks. But lately, most days I just sit at home with the TV on low. I know people are expecting me to show up to things, but I just can't seem to get myself to go.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Well, it's been building up for a while now. I suppose it started right around the time I retired from the school office. That was a little over two years ago.
During these past two years, have there been any stretches of time where you felt completely like your old self again, or has this low mood been present most of the time?

Well... no, I don't think so. It's pretty much been this way the whole time. I haven't really had any stretches where I felt like my old self again. It's just been present most every day, like a flat line, I guess.
During these past two years, have you noticed any changes in your appetite or your sleep patterns?
No, I haven't really noticed any changes with either of those. I still eat about the same as I always have, and I sleep alright, I suppose. Just the usual amount.
Do you often find yourself feeling down on yourself or feeling like you aren't as capable as you used to be?

No, not really. I don't sit around feeling bad about myself or anything like that. I still know how to do the things I've always done, so I don't feel like I'm not capable anymore. It's not really about feeling useless... it's just that flat feeling I mentioned. But no, I don't get down on myself.
When you are going about your day, do you find that you have any trouble concentrating or making decisions?

No, I haven't noticed any trouble with that. I can focus on things just fine when I need to. And making choices... well, that's just the same as it's always been. My mind works alright, I just go about my day without any real bother in that department.
Do you often find yourself feeling hopeless about the future?

No, I don't feel hopeless. I just take things one day at a time, really. I don't sit and worry about what's coming down the road. It's just... well, it's just tomorrow, isn't it? I don't feel bad about it.
Do you often find yourself being overly critical of yourself or your past actions?

No, not really. I mean, what's done is done, you know? I don't... I don't see the point in beating myself up over things from the past. I just let it be. So no, I wouldn't say I'm hard on myself like that.
Do you often feel like you are not as good as other people, or that you are not as worthy as you used to be?

No, I don't think so. I... I don't really spend time comparing myself to other folks. I'm just me. I've been around a good while now, and I figure I'm no better or worse than anybody else out there. So no, I certainly don't feel worthless or anything like that.
When you do manage to engage in your old hobbies like quilting or choir, do you find that you still get the same sense of enjoyment or pleasure from them as you used to?

No, I don't really do those things anymore. I haven't picked up my quilting in a long time, and I stopped going to choir... well, quite a while back. I just don't have the interest in them that I used to. So I couldn't tell you if I'd still enjoy them, because I just don't do them.
Do you find that you feel physically tired or exhausted during the day, even when you haven't been doing much?

No, I wouldn't say I feel exhausted. I mean, I'm 67, so I don't have the energy I had when I was young, but... I don't feel unusually tired during the day. I just kind of sit and pass the time, and I feel fine physically. So no, no real fatigue like that.
Do you find yourself becoming more easily annoyed or irritable with people or things around you lately?

No, I don't think so. I'm pretty even-keeled, mostly. I mean, things don't really bother me much these days. I just kind of keep to myself, so there's not a lot going on to get irritated about anyway. So no, I wouldn't say I'm any more annoyed than usual.
Have you ever experienced any periods of time where you felt unusually energetic, talkative, or like you didn't need as much sleep as you usually do?

No, I've never had anything like that. I'm not much of a talker anyway, to be honest. And I definitely haven't had any big bursts of energy or anything like that. I just sleep my normal amount at night, same as always. So, no, I haven't experienced that.
